text: Assumption: Insertion does not occur if the key already exists and returns an iterator to the existing entry — is this correct?

norm: insertion does not occur if the key already exists and returns an iterator to the existing entry
assumption: Insertion does not occur if the key already exists and returns an iterator to the existing entry.
